method: fdisbull-investigate: authentic bounded keyboard input; display and state separated; no direct state edits

target.edition_relation: static trace and pinned unpacked root use CIV.EXE 22de2748 (474.05); this runtime observation is the complete 474.03 install, an explicit edition difference

backend.name: DOSBox-X headless agent
backend.video: mode 5 (320x200) screenshots, mode_id stable across the sequence

route: intro completes (approx 2 min, not skipped by space or Esc)
b on settler opens the first task note
Enter dismisses the production note, city screen appears
run.note: the intro cannot be skipped with space or Esc; it runs to completion

frames.role: city screen baseline, INFO tab after founding Rome
HAPPY tab selected by key h
MAP tab selected by key m
city-view overlay entered by key v (int 3F entry 0x0013)
returns to the INFO baseline after dismissing the overlay
after key a with no unit in the city; INFO content redraw only

findings: The city screen renders the fixture inventory groups: title (ROME POP:1), CITY RESOURCES, FOOD STORAGE, INFO/HAPPY/MAP/VIEW tabs, CHANGE/BUY controls, RENAME/EXIT, and the 21-tile city map panel.
h selects HAPPY (876 changed pixels confined to the tab content area), m selects MAP (9,449 pixels; map view), v enters the full-screen city-view overlay (63,973 pixels, 99.96%).
Dismissing the overlay returns to a frame that differs from the baseline by 5 pixels, so the overlay exit restores the INFO presentation.
a with no unit in the city produced no unit-cursor panel; only the INFO content icon redraw changed (256 pixels). The handler could not be exercised without a unit.
c did not open a visible production chooser in three attempts in keyboard-only mode; the recovered static call site 0x22009 (runtime) -> 1ADE:0421 remains the only authority for that branch.
limits: The runtime install is 474.03, not the pinned 474.05 used by the static trace; cross-edition equivalence is not established.
Display deltas are measured against one baseline frame; animation and palette timing are not excluded.
No state field was read from guest memory in this pass; the observations are display-level.
A single route is not a deterministic replay claim.
next_probes: Produce a unit (production chooser or turn advance) and exercise key a with a non-empty unit list.
Capture the production chooser with mouse enabled to test the c branch display.
Read the city record fields (townbuf shield_box, status) at a breakpoint to bind display to state.
